hits.snippet: BE&K Building Group announces a CEO transition, welcoming David L. Richter to lead the company into its next chapter of growth and continued success. ... RALEIGH, NC, UNITED STATES, August 10, 2026 / EINPresswire.com/ — BE&K Building Group (BE&K), a leading design-build and construction management services company with more than 55 years of national experience delivering complex, high-performance projects, has announced that David L. Richter, PE, PMP, CCQM, has been appointed Chief Executive Officer, effective immediately. Frank Holley, who has served as the company’s CEO since 2019, has transitioned to the role of Chairman as part of a planned leadership succession.

hits.title: David L. Richter appointed CEO at BE&K Building Group | Dealroom.co
hits.snippet: David L. Richter appointed CEO at BE&K Building Group | Dealroom.co ... # David L. Richter appointed CEO at BE&K Building Group ... BE&K Building Group has appointed David L. Richter as chief executive officer, effective immediately. Frank Holley, who served as CEO since 2019, has transitioned to chairman as part of a planned leadership succession. Richter brings over 30 years of experience in executive leadership and the engineering and construction industry. Most recently, he served as executive vice president and chief growth officer at Atwell, where he led strategic initiatives that doubled the firm's annual revenue in four years. Previously, Richter spent 22 years at Hill International, rising from general counsel to CEO and increasing annual revenue from under $20 million to over $620 million. He holds multiple degrees, including a civil engineering degree and law degree from the University of Pennsylvania. BE&K Building Group is a design-build and construction management services company with more than 55 years of experience.
